invariants.rule: Shape never establishes biological compatibility. Domain, exact order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.
Forward CP-BP relations use feature-or-gene source and row-or-cell destination. Transpose/backward shares logical edge identity and uses explicit orientation metadata.

Changing dense pointers, output pointers, scalars, streams, transient workspace, value allocation address, or value generation does not rebuild immutable topology or require structural preparation unless a declared dependency changes.

No repeated native run path silently reconstructs CSR, BELL, COO, dense tensors, or canonical order. Conventional projections are legal only as explicit planner candidates with visible conversion cost.
Steady-state execution performs no hidden allocation, device selection, descriptor creation, structural hashing, host round trip, or device-wide synchronization.
Candidate selection uses complete cost, expected reuse, independent correctness, and a strong conventional fallback. Analytical models shortlist; empirical evidence decides uncertain cases.
The quantitative PBMC3K fixture is for computational correctness and performance only. Missing biological provenance must remain visible and no scientific interpretation may be inferred.
Cellerator does not become an H5AD parser, archive owner, source service, network service, or CellShard replacement. Fixture parsing remains in test and benchmark tooling.
CPE2 remains pointer-free persistent execution IR. Typed activation is non-owning. CellShard transports opaque bytes and never selects kernels or interprets Cellerator projection semantics.
Baseplane remains a separate sequence-engineering repository. CE-LIVE may consume its frozen interfaces but may not duplicate or relocate its general execution engine.
CelleraTorch never becomes the canonical allocator, parameter owner, planner, runtime, or implementation home for reusable Cellerator math.
Tensor Core metadata and kernels remain architecture-specific projection and candidate state and never enter stable biological identity.
Correctness and adversarial validation precede timing. Kernel-only timing is not sufficient for promotion.
Every source mutation occurs under a claimed task with a matching exclusive scope. Integration files are modified only by designated fan-in tasks.
